Local, and it shows

Disability support that fits Parramatta

Parramatta sits at the centre of Western Sydney and is one of the most culturally and linguistically diverse parts of the country. Families here often tell us the same thing. They want a support worker who understands their language, their faith and the way their household runs, not a stranger who needs everything explained twice.

That is the part we care about most. Ahsan Care is a registered NDIS provider, and our Sydney team supports people across Parramatta and the surrounding suburbs with everyday help at home and out in the community. If matching on background matters to you, read more about our culturally responsive care.

Four core supports, delivered in your home and your community. Every one links to the full service page so you can see exactly what is included.

Help with the personal parts of the day, from getting up and showering to dressing and medication prompts, delivered with privacy and respect. You can ask for a worker of a particular gender.

The right fit

Support workers matched to you

In a suburb as diverse as Parramatta, who turns up matters as much as what they do.

A worker who speaks your language

Parramatta is one of the most multilingual places in Sydney. Where we can, we match you with someone who speaks your first language so nothing important gets lost.

The right person for personal care

For personal care you can ask for a worker of a particular gender. We treat that as a normal request, not a special one.

Care that respects your culture

Food, prayer, modesty and family customs matter at home. Our workers are briefed to respect how your household lives day to day.

Support that fits your week

We build the roster around your routine, not ours, and we keep the same faces coming back wherever we can.

Out and about

Getting around Parramatta

Community access is a real part of many NDIS plans. Parramatta has become far easier to move around, and we help people use what is on their doorstep rather than staying home.

The new light rail

Parramatta's light rail opened in December 2024 and links Westmead, the CBD and Carlingford. We can help you learn the route and travel it with confidence.

A major transport hub

Parramatta station connects trains and buses right across Sydney, so getting to appointments, work or study is realistic with the right support beside you.

Time on the river

The ferry from Parramatta wharf is a calm way to reach the city. Community access can be about enjoying the area, not only running errands.

Close to Westmead

Many participants attend the Westmead health precinct. We can support you to and from appointments and help you keep track of what was said.

Good to know

Parramatta NDIS questions

Do you have an office in Parramatta?

No, and you do not need us to. We are a service based provider, which means our workers come to your home and support you around Parramatta. Our registered office is in Derrimut in Melbourne, and our Sydney team looks after Parramatta and Western Sydney. You can reach them on 0416 623 317.

Which suburbs around Parramatta do you cover?

We support people right across the City of Parramatta, including Harris Park, Westmead, Granville, North Parramatta, Rydalmere, Northmead and Wentworthville. We also work in nearby areas such as Auburn, Fairfield and Liverpool. If your suburb is not listed, call us and ask.

Can I choose a worker who speaks my language or is the same gender?

Yes. Parramatta is very multicultural and we try hard to match you with someone who fits, including language, gender and cultural background. For personal care in particular, asking for a worker of a certain gender is completely normal and we are glad when people tell us what they need.

Are you a registered NDIS provider?

Yes. Ahsan Care is registered with the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission, provider number 4-L7JCZ6S, and we work to the NDIS Code of Conduct. You can check any provider on the Commission website.

What does support cost in Parramatta?

Your supports are charged in line with the NDIS price guide, so the rates are set by the NDIA rather than by us. We offer a free quote, there is no call out fee, and pricing is agreed up front. If you are plan or self managed, we can walk you through how it works.

How soon can support start?

It depends on your plan and what you need, so we will give you a realistic timeframe on the first call rather than a promise we cannot keep. Matching you with the right worker matters more than rushing the first shift.

Talk to the Ahsan Care team in Parramatta

Tell us what you need and we will give you honest, clear answers. No pressure, and a free quote for your NDIS supports.
